errors.text: The fracture morphology is reversed: the target associates HPHT treatment with distributed or isolated microcracking rather than catastrophic elongated interfacial cracks, whereas the generated hypothesis labels elongated cracks as the ductile HPHT outcome and isolated microcracks as brittle.
The proposed hcp-fcc-fcc transition and pressure-stabilized FCC pathway are extrapolated from CoCrFeMnNi and are not established for FCC/B2 Al0.7CoCrFeNi under the stated HPHT conditions.
The principal quantitative outcome—approximately 1150 MPa strength together with approximately 36% tensile elongation—is omitted.
